comparison.module_origins: Exact module names and file SHA256; paths must be under newly installed matching profile, explicitly selected new current source, or matching new upstream. Original source and environment paths prohibited.

failure_handling: Record and inspect differences; do not silently loosen criteria or edit original baseline.
scope: Parent comparison criteria for fixed same-host CPU cases after a successful four-profile fresh installation; no study endpoints, checkpoint inference, GPU use or general numerical equivalence claim. Criteria fixed before amended installation.

supplemental_installed_package_checks.crem: Confirm editable origin points to new upstream and generated version matches the original expected version.
supplemental_installed_package_checks.reinvent: Check installed non-editable package Python sources and declared package data against frozen upstream; assess import from installed package as well as explicit upstream path; do not execute SAScore or load checkpoint.
